items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: He could have you make an arrangement for him, which I did. I made an arrangement ... called 'Hallelujah.'

ctx.x: But he had a great ear, and Lucky could direct a band. This is what he was primarily known for. He could have you make an arrangement for him, which I did. I made an arrangement -- I won't forget this, because I have the score right here in the house now, called "Hallelujah." (Singing) That one -- and I had it up to tempo, real fast. And he had a big band. So the way he would conduct things at a rehearsal, if you had an arrangement, he would get him a chair and sit to the side and tell you to, you know, take down…
